description: This file is a C++ header defining the class 'hostIf_STBServiceDisplayDevice' which provides APIs and data structures for managing display device information in a TR-069 compliant STB service component.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceDisplayDevice
classes.description: A class providing APIs to access and update display device information, including status, EDID, supported resolutions, and preferred resolution, for TR-069 STB services.

methods.name: hostIf_STBServiceDisplayDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display device with device ID and video output port reference.

methods.description: Performs updates on display device parameters, invoking a callback.
